title: john mod
description: this is a complete remake of the original john mod from 2011. A very small mod with most of his abilities.
body:
this mod adds john, the creature from "the john mod" from 2011. 

STATS: 60 hit points
       6 attack damage (3 hearts of damage)
       resistant to fall damage.


abilities: climb walls.


-ITEMS-: john sword: 8 damage, 51 durability, john has a 10% chance to drop a john sword.

play with golden days base and the old combat mod

adds text to the top left corner of the screen that reads "Minecraft beta 1.8.1"

-CREDITS- kurtss: for making the original john mod.
          mcreator: the "coding".

thats about it!
